# seasonal-fx

> Zero-dependency (~11 KB gzip) seasonal canvas background effects for websites: falling snow (winter), butterflies, a bee and blooming flowers from the screen edges (spring), slow sun glints and warm bokeh (summer), tumbling falling leaves (autumn / fall). One line in React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Angular or plain HTML. Click-through, SSR-safe, respects prefers-reduced-motion, can pick the season from the date and hemisphere.

Install: `npm install seasonal-fx`

React / Next.js: `import { SeasonalEffect } from 'seasonal-fx/react'` then `<SeasonalEffect season="winter" />` once in the root layout. The component is already a client component.

Plain HTML: `<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/seasonal-fx/dist/auto.js" data-seasonal-fx data-season="autumn"></script>`

Vanilla: `import { createSeasonalEffect } from 'seasonal-fx'; const fx = createSeasonalEffect({ season: 'spring' }); fx.setSeason('summer'); fx.destroy()`

Seasons: `auto` (default), `winter`, `spring`, `summer`, `autumn`, `fall` (alias of autumn). Options: `hemisphere`, `density`, `speed`, `colors`, `zIndex`, `container` (vanilla only), `className`, `respectReducedMotion`, `maxPixelRatio`.
